title: Ennie
tagline: Building a dApp around the Ennie-energy -solution, heading to the productive dataDAO
description:
The Ennie-energyproject is large entity related to self-sufficient energycommunities. One part of the solution is the management  and monitoring of data-flows (energy, payments, contracts etc.) There is a need of enduser dApp for the customer/enduser of this productive dataDAO. This work starts from the blank space.

AI-managed energy-storage is in the middle of the entity. In this hackathon the project group concentrates on creating the dApp and the interfaces to datastorages. The prior two goal is to define the needs of AI-managed energystorage.

The wild future idea is to create digital asset, which value is related to kWh. Energy community uses this digital money to pay for the energy. Used energy must fulfill certain requirements (green production, sustainable supply chain etc.). One energy community is not much, but hundreds of them makes the difference. As the process of the community runs smoothly and meets the standards (technically, ethically, sustainably) it will receive a NFT.  Checkpoint once a year.
how_its_made:
The project has just beginned so there is not much to tell about it yet. Still it is nice to add information at this point so the goal is clear and everyone can see it. After two weeks work, there will be much more to write in this paragraph. 

The project management and the activity of members is something to consider. I think it is fair to first share ideas and decide whether you are in or out. It is bit disappointing if your team isn't active, however having a seat in the team. We will see and the communication is the key :)

Team has discussed and we decided to continue with the dApp-creation to achieve concrete part of solution during the hackathon.

During the hack there has been lack of resources: it is done what has been possible to do.
